questions.text: 你心里有没有曾经对身边某个熟人产生过一时冲动的非分之想？
questions.textEn: Have you ever had a bad impulse about someone you know?

questions.text: 你有过原本想撩别人，结果反被对方高端操作套牢的经历吗？
questions.textEn: Have you ever wanted to provoke someone and ended up being locked up by the other party's high-end operation?

questions.text: 你对异性说过最让人脸红心跳、杀伤力最大的一句话是什么？
questions.textEn: What's the most blushing and deadly thing you've ever said to someone of the opposite sex?

questions.text: 你做过最隐秘、最让人心痒难耐的一次暧昧试探是什么？
questions.textEn: What was the most secretive and itchy ambiguity you've ever had?

questions.text: 除了卧室，你觉得最刺激但又有点心虚的亲密地点是哪里？
questions.textEn: Apart from the bedroom, where do you find the most exciting but somewhat distracting intimate locations?

questions.text: 你有故意挑起对方情绪后，又装无辜“撩完就跑”的坏心思经历吗？
questions.textEn: Have you deliberately provoked each other's emotions and then pretended to have innocent bad thoughts after "running away"?

questions.text: 梦里有没有梦到过和某位明星或虚构角色发生亲密接触？
questions.textEn: Have you ever dreamt of having an intimate encounter with a star or fictional character?

questions.text: 最能瞬间击中你、让你心跳过速的眼神或微表情是什么样的？
questions.textEn: What is the look or micro-expression that hits you most instantly and causes your heart to tachycardia?

questions.text: 你觉得理想的亲密关系中，拥抱、亲吻和言语表达哪个最不可或缺？
questions.textEn: Which of the following do you consider to be the most indispensable for hugging, kissing or verbal expression in an ideal intimate relationship?

questions.text: 在亲密互动中，你最喜欢对方温柔抚摸你哪个敏感部位？
questions.textEn: In an intimate interaction, which sensitive part of you do you most enjoy being gently touched by the other person?

questions.text: 你愿意和伴侣一起尝试解锁全新的亲密互动体验吗？
questions.textEn: Would you like to try and unlock new intimate experiences with your partner?

questions.text: 你有过在非常规场所发生过心跳加速的亲密接触体验吗？
questions.textEn: Have you ever had an intimate experience of heart rate acceleration in an unconventional setting?

questions.text: 除了唇部，你最享受被伴侣亲吻身体的哪个部位？
questions.textEn: In addition to the lips, which part of the body do you most enjoy being kissed by your partner?

questions.text: 你印象里最让你浑身过电、鸡皮疙瘩起一整片的一次触碰发生在哪里？
questions.textEn: Where do you remember the one touch that made you feel the most overwhelmed and goose bumps?

questions.text: 记忆中哪一次拥抱或接触，让你的心跳节奏彻底失控？
questions.textEn: Which one of these hugs or touches in your memory makes your heart rhythm completely out of control?

questions.text: 你全身上下最防不住、碰一下就会整个人软掉的敏感点在哪里？
questions.textEn: Where is the most sensitive point in your body where you can't stop it, and if you touch it, the whole person will soften?

questions.text: 在微醺放松的状态下，你更倾向于主动拥抱对方还是被拥抱？
questions.textEn: In a slightly relaxed state, are you more inclined to take the initiative to hug the other person or be hugged?

questions.text: 如果不限预算和颜值，你最想出哪位游戏角色的Cosplay？
questions.textEn: If you had unlimited budgets and faces, which player would you most like to play Cosplay with?

questions.text: 如果参加动漫展，你最想cos成哪个动漫角色？
questions.textEn: If you were to attend Comic-Con, which anime character would you most like to cosplay?

questions.text: 如果拍古装写真，你最想体验历史上的哪位风云人物？
questions.textEn: If you were to take a photo of a costume, which historical figure would you most like to experience?

questions.text: 玩剧本杀或密室时，你经历过最社死或最飙戏的扮演经历是什么？
questions.textEn: When playing script kills or secret rooms, what is the most socially deadly or dramatic acting experience you have experienced?

questions.text: 如果穿越到科幻片或赛博朋克世界，你最想扮演什么角色？
questions.textEn: What role would you most like to play if you were traveling through the world of sci-fi or cyberpunk?

questions.text: 如果置身金庸武侠世界，你最想当名门正派大侠还是邪派浪子？
questions.textEn: If you were in the world of Jin Yongwu, would you most like to be a decent hero or an evil prodigal son?

questions.text: 如果让你去经典电影里演主角，你最想演哪部电影？
questions.textEn: If you were asked to star in a classic movie, which movie would you most like to star in?

questions.text: 如果进入职场商战剧，你觉得自己更像腹黑大佬还是热血菜鸟？
questions.textEn: If you enter a professional business drama, do you feel more like a belly-black big shot or a hot-blooded rookie?

questions.text: 你玩剧本杀时最喜欢抽到什么设定（如凶手/感情线/反派）？
questions.textEn: What settings do you most like to draw when playing script kills (e.g. killer/emotional line/villain)?

questions.text: 如果可以扮演一天反派大Boss，你最想去完成什么反常动作？
questions.textEn: If you could play the villain boss for a day, what anomalous action would you most like to complete?

questions.text: 你觉得自己迄今为止做成过最牛、最值得骄傲的一件事是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the one thing you feel most proud of that you have done so far?

questions.text: 你觉得自己做过最疯狂、最打破常规的事情是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you think is the craziest, most unconventional thing you've ever done?

questions.text: 如果不考虑金钱和现实限制，你最想实现的个人愿望是什么？
questions.textEn: What personal aspirations do you most want to achieve if you do not consider monetary and realistic constraints?

questions.text: 你人生中冒过最大、最悬的一场风险/豪赌是什么？
questions.textEn: What has been the biggest and biggest risk/gamble you have ever taken in your life?

questions.text: 回顾过往，你做出过最正确、最骄傲的一个人生决定是什么？
questions.textEn: Looking back, what was the most correct and proud life decision you have ever made?

questions.text: 你差一点点就实现了，但功亏一篑的遗憾目标是什么？
questions.textEn: You almost achieved it, but what was the goal of the unfortunate loss?

questions.text: 你打死也不想从事的人生职业或行业是什么？
questions.textEn: What is your life's profession or industry that you don't want to kill?

questions.text: 你坚持了最多年、从未放弃的一项爱好是什么？
questions.textEn: What's one hobby you've been sticking to for years that you've never given up on?

questions.text: 你经历过最幸运、最像天赐良机的一件事是什么？
questions.textEn: What's one of the luckiest and most godsend-like things you've ever experienced?

questions.text: 让你觉得完全无法适应、最排斥常住的城市类型是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the type of city that makes you feel totally uncomfortable and most excluded from living in?

questions.text: 十年后，你希望自己处于安稳惬意还是自由探险的生活状态？
questions.textEn: Ten years later, do you want to live in peace or freedom of adventure?

questions.text: 你过去曾经极度执着，但如今彻底释怀放下的事情是什么？
questions.textEn: You used to be obsessed, but now what is it about letting go?

questions.text: 如果可以任意选择，你梦想中定居养老的理想城市是哪里？
questions.textEn: If you could choose, what would be your dream retirement city?

questions.text: 你最害怕陷入的糟糕人生状态是什么样的？
questions.textEn: What is your worst fear of falling into?

questions.text: 如果可以立刻获得一项超能力，你希望是隐身、飞天还是读心？为什么？
questions.textEn: If you could instantly acquire a superpower, would you prefer to be invisible, fly or read your mind? Why?

questions.text: 你最喜欢什么形式的派对或聚会氛围？
questions.textEn: What's your favorite type of party or gathering atmosphere?

questions.text: 酒桌上你最讨厌哪种形式的劝酒或敬酒套路？
questions.textEn: What form of persuasion or toast routine do you dislike the most at the wine table?

questions.text: 你经历过最尴尬、最想原地消失的相亲或尬聊场合是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the most awkward or embarrassing conversation you have ever had where you most wanted to disappear?

questions.text: 你在朋友圈最常潜水看谁的动态但不点赞？
questions.textEn: Who do you dive most often in your circle of friends to see but don't like?

questions.text: 你遭遇过最惨烈的一次社交立人设“翻车”现场是什么？
questions.textEn: What was the most tragic socialite “rollover” scene you ever encountered?

questions.text: 你最长一次故意已读不回别人信息是因为什么？
questions.textEn: Why did you deliberately fail to read someone else's information for the longest time?

questions.text: 你找过最离谱但成功的爽约/放鸽子理由是什么？
questions.textEn: What are some of the most outrageous but successful reasons you have looked for to refuse an appointment/release a pigeon?

questions.text: 电梯里碰到不太熟的邻居或同事，你最怕的寒暄话是什么？
questions.textEn: You met a neighbor or colleague you didn't know very well in the elevator. What is your biggest fear of cold talk?

questions.text: 聚会气氛冷场时，你做过最高情商的救场/圆场操作是什么？
questions.textEn: When the party atmosphere was cold, what rescue/roundhouse operation did you do with the highest EQ?

questions.text: 工作中你最敬而远之、避之不及的同事类型是什么样的？
questions.textEn: What is your most distant and unavoidable type of colleague at work?

questions.text: 社交场合中你最难以忍受的虚伪客套是什么？
questions.textEn: What is your most intolerable form of hypocrisy in social situations?

questions.text: 你曾经讲错话或叫错名字导致最社死的一段对话是什么？
questions.textEn: What was the last conversation you had where you said the wrong word or called the wrong name that led to your death?

questions.text: 你在社交场合中最喜欢扮演掌控全场的“气氛组”还是安详吃瓜的“背景板”？
questions.textEn: Do you prefer to play the "atmosphere group" that controls the whole venue in social situations or the "background board" that eats melons peacefully?

questions.text: 你哪一次喝多之后情绪彻底失控破防？发了什么疯？
questions.textEn: Which one time did you get completely out of control after drinking too much? What's wrong?

questions.text: 你觉得自己在性格上最难以克服的一个致命弱点是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you feel is one of your most insurmountable weaknesses in your personality?

questions.text: 你有没有过表面笑嘻嘻说没事，转头自己躲起来哭的经历？
questions.textEn: Have you ever had the experience of smiling on the surface and saying that it was okay, turning your head and hiding and crying?

questions.text: 深夜独处时，最容易让你陷入抑郁或焦虑的念头是什么？
questions.textEn: What are the most depressing or anxious thoughts you have when you're alone late at night?

questions.text: 近期哪件事或谁的一句话，彻底戳中你痛处让你心理防线崩溃？
questions.textEn: What recent event or someone's sentence completely pokes you in pain and breaks down your psychological defense line?

questions.text: 你在人际交往中最害怕被别人评价或戳中什么痛点？
questions.textEn: What pain points in interpersonal relationships are you most afraid of being judged or poked at?

questions.text: 你自己都非常讨厌但总是控制不住的坏习惯是什么？
questions.textEn: What are some bad habits you hate so much that you can't control them?

questions.text: 如果评估你自己，你觉得你能力或性格上最大的短板是什么？
questions.textEn: If you evaluate yourself, what do you think are your biggest weaknesses in ability or character?

questions.text: 你坦然承认的内心最软弱、最需要保护的地方是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you openly acknowledge is the weakest and most in need of protection?

questions.text: 在感情或友情中，你是否有过极度害怕被抛弃的焦虑感？
questions.textEn: Have you ever had anxiety in your relationship or friendship that you were extremely afraid of being abandoned?

questions.text: 你做过最认怂、最服软的一次决定或瞬间是什么？
questions.textEn: What was the most cognitive, submissive decision or moment you ever made?

questions.text: 对于具体的某种事物（如高处/昆虫/黑暗），你最深刻的恐惧是什么？
questions.textEn: What is your deepest fear of something specific (e.g., heights/insects/darkness)?

questions.text: 哪种性格类型的人，是你接触下来觉得最难沟通、最拿他没办法的？
questions.textEn: What type of personality type do you find the most difficult to communicate with and the most difficult to do with him?

questions.text: 多年以后，你希望朋友们以怎样的词汇或印象记住你？
questions.textEn: In years to come, what words or impressions would you like your friends to remember you by?

questions.text: 摔过很多跤之后，你现在最深信不疑的人生道理是什么？
questions.textEn: After a lot of falls, what is your most profound belief in life right now?

questions.text: 你上一次感到灵魂无比清醒透彻的独处时刻是在什么时候？
questions.textEn: When was the last time you felt your soul was awake and alone?

questions.text: 如果医生告知你生命只剩最后一个月，你清单上的前三件事是什么？
questions.textEn: What are the top three things on your list if your doctor tells you that you only have one month left to live?

questions.text: 遭遇了哪件事之后，你曾经坚守的人生价值观发生了剧烈动摇？
questions.textEn: What happened to you that violently shook the values you once held in your life?

questions.text: 过去你曾奉为圭臬、如今却深深怀疑的一句鸡汤信条是什么？
questions.textEn: What is a chicken soup creed you once believed in but now deeply suspect?

questions.text: 你感受过最强烈的“人生毫无意义”的虚无感是在什么时候？
questions.textEn: When have you felt the strongest sense of meaninglessness in your life?

questions.text: 剔除掉社会的期望，你个人赋予自己活着的本质价值是什么？
questions.textEn: Eliminate the expectations of society, what is the intrinsic value you personally give yourself to live?

questions.text: 在你看来，“成功的人生”是用内心充实衡量的，还是用外部成就衡量的？
questions.textEn: In your opinion, is “successful life” measured by inner fulfillment or external achievement?

questions.text: 你压在潜意识最深处、从不敢对外公开的内心恐惧是什么？
questions.textEn: What is your innermost fear of being pressed into your subconscious and never daring to reveal it to the public?

questions.text: 你最勇敢地正面硬刚、并成功跨越的一次恐惧经历是什么？
questions.textEn: What was the one fearful experience you most courageously faced and successfully navigated?

questions.text: 那种说不清道不明、突然袭来的莫名的不安感，通常源自什么？
questions.textEn: What is usually the source of that inexplicable, sudden sense of unease?

questions.text: 失眠的深夜里，你对不可预测的未来产生的最大焦虑是什么？
questions.textEn: What are your biggest anxieties about the unpredictable future during the late nights of insomnia?

questions.text: 面对某种无法承受的后果时，你采取过最严重的逃避手段是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the worst escape you have ever taken in the face of some unbearable consequence?

questions.text: 如果现实逼迫你放弃，你最不敢想象自己失去的人或事物是什么？
questions.textEn: If reality forces you to give up, what is the last thing you would dare to imagine losing?

questions.text: 当你感到前所未有的迷茫时，你通常依靠什么力量重新站起来？
questions.textEn: What strength do you typically rely on to get back on your feet when you feel more lost than ever before?

questions.text: 你目前生命中最难厘清、最让你感到困惑疲惫的一段关系是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the most confusing and exhausting relationship you currently have in your life?

questions.text: 你和父母之间存在但一直说不出口的心理隔阂是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the psychological barrier between you and your parents that you have been unable to describe?

questions.text: 你和最要好的朋友之间，最难坦诚相告的一句真心话是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the hardest truth between you and your best friend to tell honestly?

questions.text: 在过往的人际交往中，你觉得自己辜负过谁的一片深情或信任？
questions.textEn: Whom do you feel you have failed in affection or trust in past relationships?

questions.text: 你理想中彻底无条件信任、毫无保留的深度关系是什么样的？
questions.textEn: What is your ideal deep relationship of total and unconditional trust and unreserved trust?

questions.text: 因为自己的任性或疏忽，你亲手搞砸过最遗憾的一段关系是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the most regrettable relationship you have ever personally screwed up because of your own willfulness or negligence?

questions.text: 你是否曾因为自己的冷漠或退缩，伤透了一个关心你的人？
questions.textEn: Have you ever hurt someone who cares about you because of your indifference or withdrawal?

questions.text: 你觉得长久稳定的人际关系，本质上是靠“吸引”还是靠“维系”？
questions.textEn: Do you think long-term stable interpersonal relationships are inherently based on "attraction" or "maintenance"?

questions.text: 别人常用来形容你、但你自己内心极度否认或抗拒的特质是什么？
questions.textEn: What are some traits that people often use to describe you, but that you yourself deeply deny or resist?

questions.text: 你隐藏在社交面具之下、但自己其实非常喜欢的隐秘一面是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the hidden side of you that you hide behind your social mask, but that you really like?

questions.text: 为了维持某种形象或妥协现实，你做过最违背内心的自欺欺人是什么？
questions.textEn: In order to maintain a certain image or compromise reality, what is the most self-deception you have done against your heart?

questions.text: 在某个特定瞬间，连你自己都感到无比陌生的那个阴暗/冷酷的自己是什么样的？
questions.textEn: At a particular moment, what was that dark/cold self that you felt so alien to?

questions.text: 如果给你一次机会抹去过往的一段经历，你最想重写哪段历史？
questions.textEn: If you were given a chance to erase a past experience, which history would you most like to rewrite?

questions.text: 抛开身份标签，你觉得你真正看清并接纳真实的自己了吗？
questions.textEn: Aside from identity labels, do you feel like you really see and embrace who you really are?

questions.text: 如果用三个关键词来总结你灵魂的核心内核，会是哪三个词？
questions.textEn: If you were to use three keywords to summarize the core core of your soul, which three words would they be?

questions.text: 时光流逝这么久，至今依然横在你心头未曾平息的一件事是什么？
questions.textEn: What's the one thing that hasn't settled in your mind after all this time?

questions.text: 你心中是否有过一位觉得深深亏欠、但再无机会亲口说抱歉的人？
questions.textEn: Have you ever felt deeply indebted to someone who didn't have a chance to say sorry?

questions.text: 对于曾经犯下的某个过错，你最终选择放过自己并实现和解了吗？
questions.textEn: For a mistake you made, did you finally choose to let yourself go and reconcile?

questions.text: 因为当时的怯懦或犹豫，你错过的最令人惋惜的机会是什么？
questions.textEn: Because of the timidity or hesitation at the time, what was the most regrettable opportunity you missed?

questions.text: 如果时光倒流回三年前，你做出改变的第一个决定会是什么？
questions.textEn: If time went back three years, what would be your first decision to change?

questions.text: 你觉得人生的遗憾更多是因为“做错了”还是因为“没去做”？
questions.textEn: Do you feel that life's regrets are more due to "doing wrong" or "not doing it"?

questions.text: 在现实利益与内心情感之间，你做过最违背原则但无可奈何的取舍是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the most irreconcilable trade-off you have made between your real interests and your inner feelings?

questions.text: 你愿意为了无拘无束的个人自由，去放弃世俗意义上的安稳生活吗？
questions.textEn: Are you willing to give up secular security for the sake of unfettered personal freedom?

questions.text: 随着年龄增长，你曾经坚守的哪条道德/做事底线被你重新退让定义了？
questions.textEn: Which ethic/bottom line of doing things that you once adhered to is defined by your recession as you get older?

questions.text: 你愿意为了追求极致的职业梦想，去牺牲当下的舒适区与人际陪伴吗？
questions.textEn: Are you willing to sacrifice your current comfort zone and interpersonal companionship in pursuit of your ultimate professional dream?

questions.text: 如果只能挑选一项作为人生基石，你最看重的品质是什么？（如诚实/勇敢/善良）
questions.textEn: If you could only pick one quality as the cornerstone of your life, what would it be? (e.g. honesty/bravery/kindness)

questions.text: 在你目前的人生阶段，你面临过最拉扯、最矛盾的一次双选题是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the most tug-of-war and contradictory double-choice question you have faced in your current life?

questions.text: 在追求效率的时代里，你坚守的最“不实用”但温暖的价值观是什么？
questions.textEn: What are the most “impractical” but warming values you adhere to in an age of efficiency?

questions.text: 在你想象的终极人生蓝图中，你最憧憬的大结局画面是什么样的？
questions.textEn: In your vision of the ultimate blueprint for life, what is the big picture you most yearn for?

questions.text: 你理想中理想的未来五年，生活状态与精神面貌应该是怎样的？
questions.textEn: What should your ideal lifestyle and mental outlook look like in the next five years?

questions.text: 当生命走到终点回顾一生时，你希望自己能庆幸当年做对了什么？
questions.textEn: When life comes to an end and you look back on your life, what do you wish you had done right?

questions.text: 当你老了优雅地坐在摇椅上，你希望自己以怎样的心态面对岁月？
questions.textEn: When you are old and elegantly sitting in a rocking chair, how do you want to face your years?

questions.text: 面对容颜衰老和身体机能退化，你有过真实的年龄恐惧感吗？
questions.textEn: Have you ever had a genuine fear of age in the face of ageing and physical deterioration?

questions.text: 你希望未来的自己能够拥有一份怎样的心境去面对未知？
questions.textEn: What state of mind do you want your future self to have to face the unknown?

questions.text: 如果可以给十年前的自己寄去一封信，你最想写下的三个词是什么？
questions.textEn: If you could send yourself a letter from ten years ago, what three words would you most like to write?

questions.text: 你觉得一个人真正走向成熟的标志事件或心态转变是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you think is a sign of a person's true maturity or mindset shift?

questions.text: 你心目中理想的“自由”生活状态，具体长什么样？
questions.textEn: What does your ideal “free” life look like?

questions.text: 在你生命中最黑暗或艰难的时期，是什么支撑你熬过来的？
questions.textEn: What sustained you through the darkest or hardest times of your life?

questions.text: 如果把目前的人生拍成一部电影，你觉得现在的剧情进行到了什么章节？
questions.textEn: If you made your current life into a movie, what chapter do you think the current plot has progressed to?

questions.text: 你认为人的一生中，陪伴、成就和自我体验三者该怎么排序？
questions.textEn: How do you rank companionship, achievement and self-experience in a person's life?

questions.text: 有哪些事是你坚持做了很久之后，才发现它深刻改变了你的？
questions.textEn: What are some things you persevere on doing long before discovering that it has profoundly changed yours?

questions.text: 如果明天所有现实压力都消失，你最想投入去干的一件事是什么？
questions.textEn: If all the real-world stress disappeared tomorrow, what's the one thing you'd most like to put in?

questions.text: 在面对重大人生选择时，最容易让你陷入犹豫不决的原因是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the easiest reason for you to hesitate when faced with a major life choice?

questions.text: 你是否曾经很害怕被身边的人看穿真实的自己？为什么？
questions.textEn: Have you ever been afraid of being seen through by those around you and why?

questions.text: 面对不可控的变化时，你习惯用什么方式建立安全感？
questions.textEn: In what ways are you accustomed to building security in the face of uncontrollable change?

questions.text: 你觉得自己在人际关系中最大的不安全感来源于什么？
questions.textEn: What do you feel is the source of your greatest insecurity in relationships?

questions.text: 如果有一天必须独自一人生活在陌生的环境，你最担心的是什么？
questions.textEn: If you had to live alone in an unfamiliar environment one day, what would you be most worried about?

questions.text: 社会或长辈赋予你的哪种期待，曾让你感到最沉重的压迫感？
questions.textEn: What expectations from society or your elders have made you feel the most oppressed?

questions.text: 你最害怕失去的一项品质或内心感受是什么？
questions.textEn: What is one quality or inner feeling you are most afraid of losing?

questions.text: 你觉得能够维持一段终生好友关系的底线原则是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you think are the bottom-line principles that can sustain a lifelong friendship?

questions.text: 当关系出现裂痕时，你通常是主动沟通解决，还是冷处理顺其自然？
questions.textEn: When there is a rift in the relationship, do you usually take the initiative to communicate and solve it, or is the cold treatment natural?

questions.text: 在所有社交关系中，你觉得最让你感到轻松舒适的状态是怎样的？
questions.textEn: Of all the social relationships, what do you find most relaxing and comfortable?

questions.text: 你有没有过某段时间非常渴望独处、甚至想切断所有社交连接？
questions.textEn: Have you ever been desperate to be alone or even cut off all social connections?

questions.text: 在沟通中，哪种表达方式最容易让你彻底闭上心门拒绝交流？
questions.textEn: In communication, what is the easiest way to say something that makes you completely close your mind and refuse to communicate?

questions.text: 你觉得家人、朋友和伴侣，各自在你生命中扮演的最不可替代的角色是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you think are the most irreplaceable roles that family, friends, and partners each play in your life?

questions.text: 你曾从一位重要的人身上学到的最深刻的人生功课是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the most profound life lesson you have ever learned from an important person?

questions.text: 如果可以把自己身上的某种性格特点放大10倍，你希望是哪种？
questions.textEn: If you could magnify a personality trait by a factor of 10, what would it be?

questions.text: 你觉得当下的自己，和三年前相比最大的心态进步是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you think is your biggest mindset improvement compared to three years ago?

questions.text: 你在什么时候最容易对自我产生怀疑？当时又是怎么调整过来的？
questions.textEn: When are you most likely to doubt yourself? How did you adjust back then?

questions.text: 你认为自己最独特、最不随波逐流的一面体现在哪里？
questions.textEn: Where do you see yourself as the most unique and unconventional?

questions.text: 如果在别人眼里你是个情绪稳定的人，你内心的真实波澜通常是什么样？
questions.textEn: If you are an emotionally stable person in the eyes of others, what are the real waves in your heart?

questions.text: 你最希望自己具备但目前还在努力培养的一种心态是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the mindset you would most like to have but are currently working on developing?

questions.text: 你最享受独处时做的哪件事？它带给你怎样的内心体验？
questions.textEn: What did you enjoy most about being alone? What inner experience does it give you?

questions.text: 你人生中感到最遗憾但已经无法弥补的一件事是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the one thing you regret most in your life that you can no longer make up for?

questions.text: 有没有哪一句当时没说出口的话，至今还在你脑海里回响？
questions.textEn: Are there any words that have not been spoken at that time that still resonate in your mind?

questions.text: 你觉得自己在成长过程中，付出代价最大的一个误区或执念是什么？
questions.textEn: What do you feel is the most costly misconception or obsession you have had growing up?

questions.text: 如果可以重新选择一次过去人生的某个岔路口，你会换个方向吗？
questions.textEn: If you could reselect a fork in your past life, would you change direction?

questions.text: 因为年少轻狂或不成熟，你曾经做过最后悔的一件决定是什么？
questions.textEn: What was one decision you regretted because you were young or immature?

questions.text: 你觉得遗憾和痛苦，给你的性格成长留下了什么正面的印记？
questions.textEn: What positive imprint do you feel regret and pain leave on your character growth?

questions.text: 有没有哪段渐行渐远的关系，是你至今想起依然感到唏嘘的？
questions.textEn: Is there any relationship that is gradually drifting away that you still feel sighing about to this day?

questions.text: 你认为在工作中，“兴趣激情”和“稳定高报酬”哪个更决定长久幸福感？
questions.textEn: Which do you think determines long-term happiness more at work, “passion” or “steady high pay”?

questions.text: 在人生的这个阶段，你觉得什么样的事情才值得你投入宝贵的心力？
questions.textEn: What do you think is worth investing in at this stage of your life?

questions.text: 你对“成功”的定义，相比几年前发生了怎样具体的改变？
questions.textEn: How has your definition of success changed from what it was a few years ago?

questions.text: 你如何看待“顺其自然”和“全力争取”这两种生活态度？
questions.textEn: What do you think about the two life attitudes of “let it go” and “strive for it”?

questions.text: 你最排斥社会大众流行推崇的哪种生活哲学或处世观念？
questions.textEn: Which philosophy of life or concept of life do you most reject as popular in society?

questions.text: 如果必须在“绝对真诚”和“照顾他人情绪”之间选一个，你倾向选哪个？
questions.textEn: If you had to choose between being “absolutely sincere” and “caring for others' emotions,” which would you prefer?

questions.text: 在你看重的诸多品质里，哪一种是你挑选深交朋友的必要条件？
questions.textEn: Which of the many qualities do you value as a prerequisite for choosing deep friendships?

questions.text: 你最期待自己在未来3到5年内实现的一个突破是什么？
questions.textEn: What is the one breakthrough you are most looking forward to achieving in the next 3-5 years?

questions.text: 在你理想的晚年生活图景里，最不可或缺的元素是什么？
questions.textEn: What are the most indispensable elements of your ideal vision of later life?

questions.text: 面对不确定性越来越强的未来，你做过哪些心理或现实准备？
questions.textEn: What psychological or realistic preparations have you made for an increasingly uncertain future?

questions.text: 如果你可以在未来的某个时刻给当下的自己发一条提醒，你觉得会是什么？
questions.textEn: If you could send yourself a reminder at some point in the future, what would it be?

questions.text: 你希望未来5年后的自己，能够拥有怎样的生活节奏？
questions.textEn: What kind of rhythm do you hope to have in the next 5 years?

questions.text: 如果有机会去体验一种完全不同的人生轨迹，你最想试试哪种？
questions.textEn: If you had the opportunity to experience a completely different life trajectory, which would you most like to try?

questions.text: 当你回忆今晚的聚会时，你希望未来的自己记住今晚的什么感觉？
questions.textEn: When you recall tonight's party, what do you want your future self to remember about tonight?

questions.text: 用浓郁的家乡方言腔调，感情澎湃地播报你今晚吃过的菜品名
questions.textEn: Emotionally broadcast the name of the dish you ate tonight in a rich hometown dialect

questions.text: 配上一张搞怪自拍，把当下的真实心情发一条朋友圈并保留一小时
questions.textEn: With a funny selfie, make a circle of friends and keep the real mood for an hour

questions.text: 用严肃的新闻主播腔调，一本正经地朗读桌上的菜单或饮料成分表
questions.textEn: With a serious news anchor tone, read the menu or drink ingredient list on the table in a serious way

questions.text: 用即兴Rap的节奏和动作，对着正对面的玩家单膝下跪说“我真的太崇拜你了”
questions.textEn: With the rhythm and movement of improvised rap, kneel down on one knee to the player in front of you and say "I really adore you"

questions.text: 用最反差的夹子音/粗犷音，激情唱出某首热门神曲的副歌两句
questions.textEn: Passionately sing the two lines of a popular divine song with the most contrasting clip/rough tone

questions.text: 以现场随机三个物品为要素，30秒内即兴编造一个反转搞笑的小故事
questions.textEn: Improvise a funny reversal story in 30 seconds with three random items on-site as the element

questions.text: 做出一张全场公认最挤眉弄眼的鬼脸造型，保持5秒接受大家拍照
questions.textEn: Make a grimace that is recognized as the most squeezing and eye-catching grimace in the whole hall, and keep it for 5 seconds to accept everyone's photos

questions.text: 站起来充满活力地连续完成15个开合跳，并大声数出来
questions.textEn: Stand up, do 15 consecutive jumps with energy, and count them out loud

questions.text: 用软萌的奶音撒娇语气，播报全场明天的天气预报
questions.textEn: With a soft, spoiled tone of voice, broadcast the weather forecast for tomorrow.

questions.text: 当场做10个标准俯卧撑（做不到的可用标准平板支撑20秒代替）
questions.textEn: Do 10 standard push-ups on the spot (can't do standard flat support for 20 seconds instead)

questions.text: 用唐僧式啰嗦无比的语调，向全场念一段纸巾/饮料包装袋上的说明文
questions.textEn: Read a paragraph of the instructions on the paper towel/beverage packaging bag to the whole hall in a tang monk-like rumble

questions.text: 把一句极为过气的土味情话更新到微信状态或社交账号上
questions.textEn: Update an extremely over-the-top local affair to a WeChat status or social account

questions.text: 头顶一个水杯或水果，保持平衡走完一圈且不能掉落
questions.textEn: A glass of water or fruit above the head, balanced and can't fall after a lap

questions.text: 做出中二奥特曼发光姿势或超人起飞Pose，定格15秒接受大家检阅
questions.textEn: Make a Sophomore Ultraman glowing pose or Superman take off Pose, freeze for 15 seconds for everyone to review

questions.text: 模仿企鹅摇摇晃晃走路的样子，在场地中央来回走15秒
questions.textEn: Walk back and forth for 15 seconds in the middle of the field, imitating the way a penguin shakes and walks

questions.text: 给微信最近联系人列表第一位好友发送：“其实我一直暗恋你”，3秒后撤回
questions.textEn: Sent to the first friend on WeChat's recent contact list: "Actually, I've been secretly in love with you", retracted after 3 seconds

questions.text: 给各位表演一曲汽车摇（很简单的！来吧！）
questions.textEn: Perform a car shake for everyone (it's easy! Come on!)

questions.text: 打开你的音乐App，将“历史播放记录”第一页当众展示给全场看
questions.textEn: Open your music app and show the first page of History to the whole audience

questions.text: 讲一个全场没人听过的地道冷笑话，如果没人笑你自己罚一口
questions.textEn: Tell a cynical joke that no one in the whole room has heard. If no one laughs, you will be punished yourself.

questions.text: 用霸道总裁沉声道：“女人，你在玩火”的油腻语气说一句全场台词
questions.textEn: With the greasy tone of "Woman, you are playing with fire", the overbearing president said in a deep voice,

questions.text: 模仿名媛/豪门贵妇翘着小拇指走路拿酒杯的姿态摇曳10秒
questions.textEn: Imitating a lady/magnificent lady walking with her little finger and swaying the glass for 10 seconds

questions.text: 横着身子模仿横行霸道的螃蟹，边走边吐气10秒
questions.textEn: Imitating rampant domineering crabs, walk and exhale for 10 seconds

questions.text: 用浮夸的舞台剧/戏精戏剧腔，向全场做自我介绍30秒
questions.textEn: Introduce yourself to the whole scene for 30 seconds with a pompous stage play/drama essence

questions.text: 用最深情的语气，对着一只水杯或者一把椅子朗诵一段情话
questions.textEn: Recite a love sentence in the most affectionate tone to a glass or chair

questions.text: 当场模仿一种小动物（如猫咪叫/小狗伸懒腰）并坚持20秒
questions.textEn: Imitate a small animal on the spot (like a cat barking/puppy stretching) and hold on for 20 seconds

questions.text: 面向左边第一位玩家，两人大方击掌并保持手掌贴合15秒
questions.textEn: Facing the first player on the left, the two of them give a high-five and hold their palms together for 15 seconds

questions.text: 轻轻靠在右边玩家的肩膀上，静止保持一分钟
questions.textEn: Gently lean on the right player's shoulder and hold still for a minute

questions.text: 给身边最靠近你的玩家一个真诚而温暖的拥抱
questions.textEn: Give the player closest to you a sincere and warm hug

questions.text: 拉起左边玩家的手，轻轻摇晃并撒娇说“带我玩嘛”
questions.textEn: Take the player's hand on the left, gently shake it and say "Take me to play"

questions.text: 伸出手向右边玩家做一个中世纪欧式优雅的礼节性握手
questions.textEn: Reach out to the right and make a medieval European courtesy handshake

questions.text: 和右边玩家十指相扣，保持双手交缠20秒
questions.textEn: Interlock your fingers with the player on the right and keep your hands entangled for 20 seconds

questions.text: 牵着右边玩家的手，像跳芭蕾一样拉着对方原地转一圈
questions.textEn: Hold the player's hand on the right and turn around like a ballet

questions.text: 牵起右边玩家的手并高高举起，像胜利者一样大喊“我们是冠军”
questions.textEn: Take the player's hand on the right and hold it high, shouting "We are the champions" like the winner

questions.text: 和左边玩家鼻尖贴鼻尖近距离对视10秒，期间谁先笑谁罚酒
questions.textEn: Look closely at the tip of the nose of the player on the left for 10 seconds. During this period, who smiles first and who fines alcohol?

questions.text: 和右边玩家脸颊轻轻贴在一起，合影一张记录此刻
questions.textEn: and gently press the cheeks of the player on the right side together, taking a photo of the moment

questions.text: 为左边玩家提供10秒捏肩放松按摩服务
questions.textEn: 10-second shoulder massage for left player to relax

questions.text: 张开双臂，给右边的玩家一个极其热烈的熊抱
questions.textEn: Open your arms and give the player on the right an extremely warm bear hug

questions.text: 握住对面玩家的手掌，用手指为其按摩手掌穴位10秒
questions.textEn: Hold the opposing player's palm and massage the palm acupuncture point with your finger for 10 seconds

questions.text: 与左边玩家深情对视10秒，全程不许眨眼不许笑
questions.textEn: Look at the player on the left for 10 seconds, without blinking or laughing

questions.text: 挽着左边玩家的手臂，像老姐妹/好哥们一样保持到下一轮
questions.textEn: Hold the player's arm on the left until the next round like an old sister/buddy

questions.text: 与全场每位玩家依次轻柔碰拳，并说一句专属的夸奖
questions.textEn: Gently punch each player in turn and say a special compliment

questions.text: 亲手拿一块食物/水果，亲切地喂给左边玩家吃一口
questions.textEn: Take a piece of food/fruit in your hand and graciously feed it to the player on the left

questions.text: 坐在左边玩家的大腿上，保持姿势5秒钟
questions.textEn: Sit on the left player's lap and hold position for 5 seconds

questions.text: 闭上眼睛，由右边玩家拿起一块食物喂进你嘴里
questions.textEn: Close your eyes and let the player on the right pick up a piece of food to feed into your mouth

questions.text: 尝试将左边的玩家公主抱起来（双脚离地即可），保持3秒
questions.textEn: Try to hold the player princess on the left (feet off the ground) for 3 seconds

questions.text: 与左边玩家额头贴着额头，感受彼此呼吸10秒
questions.textEn: Breathe into each other for 10 seconds with the player on the left, with their foreheads pressed against their foreheads

questions.text: 和左边玩家背靠背双手紧锁，相互支撑保持10秒
questions.textEn: and the player on the left, back to back, hands locked, support each other for 10 seconds

questions.text: 搂住右边玩家的腰部，两人同步原地转一个华尔兹圈
questions.textEn: Holding the player's waist on the right side, the two of them simultaneously turn a waltz circle in place

questions.text: 温柔地帮对面玩家整理一下衣服领子或头发
questions.textEn: Gently tidy up the collar or hair of the opposing player

questions.text: 蒙上眼睛，由左边玩家小心翼翼地喂你喝一口饮料/酒
questions.textEn: Blindfolded, the player on the left carefully feeds you a drink/liquor

questions.text: 由你右边的玩家为你设计一个发型/造型，保持到下一轮
questions.textEn: Have the player to your right design a hairstyle/styling for you to keep until the next round

questions.text: 在全场见证下，与右边自愿的玩家浪漫热吻5秒
questions.textEn: Romantic kiss with a volunteer player on the right for 5 seconds, as witnessed by the whole court

questions.text: 凑到右边玩家耳边，用极具诱惑力的低音炮耳语一句私密情话
questions.textEn: Reach to the player on the right and whisper an intimate affair with a very seductive subwoofer

questions.text: 与左边玩家互换身上的外衣/外套，并穿着完成下一轮游戏
questions.textEn: Swap your outerwear/jacket with the player on the left and wear it to complete the next round

questions.text: 靠近右边玩家耳根处轻轻吹一口气，直到对方耳朵发红
questions.textEn: Take a gentle breath near the root of the player's ear on the right until the other person's ear turns red.

questions.text: 在右边玩家的脸颊上留下一个清晰的唇印吻痕
questions.textEn: Leaves a clear lipstick nose mark on the player's cheek on the right

questions.text: 把左边玩家拉到角落，贴着对方耳朵咬耳朵密语10秒
questions.textEn: Pull the player on the left to the corner and bite the ear against the other party's ear for 10 seconds

questions.text: 与左边玩家互换一件身上的饰品（戒指/项链/手链）戴上
questions.textEn: Swap an accessory (ring/necklace/bracelet) with the player on the left

questions.text: 与左边玩家靠近到距离不足5厘米，维持5秒呼吸交融不许避开
questions.textEn: Approach the player on the left to a distance of less than 5 cm, and keep breathing for 5 seconds. Do not avoid it.

questions.text: 走向附近一位路人，礼貌而自信地大方索要联系方式
questions.textEn: Walk to a passer-by nearby and politely and confidently ask for contact information

questions.text: 面向服务员或店员，大方比个赞并微笑说：“今天辛苦啦，加油！”
questions.textEn: To the waiter or clerk, give a generous compliment and smile and say, "Thank you for your hard work today!"

questions.text: 找一位路过的陌生人，礼貌请对方帮你和朋友拍一张合影
questions.textEn: Find a passing stranger and politely ask them to take a picture with you and your friend

questions.text: 走到隔壁桌面前，真诚微笑地对其中一位说：“打扰啦，你今天穿搭真好看！”
questions.textEn: Go to the next table and say to one of them with a sincere smile: "Excuse me, you look great today!"

questions.text: 路过一位陌生人时，一本正经地对他说一句无害的土味情话
questions.textEn: When passing by a stranger, say a harmless earthy affectionate word to him in a serious way

questions.text: 礼貌询问附近一位路人，能否一起拍张搞笑双人合影
questions.textEn: Politely ask a passerby nearby if we can take a funny photo of two people together

questions.text: 去吧台或隔壁桌，请一位陌生人帮你推荐一款他最喜欢的饮品
questions.textEn: Go to the bar or the table next door and ask a stranger to recommend one of his favorite drinks

questions.text: 向一位路过的陌生人远距离送出一个优雅而幽默的飞吻
questions.textEn: Sending an elegant and humorous flying kiss to a passing stranger at a distance

questions.text: 走过去对隔壁桌的朋友说：“祝你们今天好运满满，用餐愉快！”
questions.textEn: I walked over to my friend at the next table and said, “Good luck and enjoy your meal today!”

questions.text: 礼貌向附近一位路人询问时间，并在离开前夸赞一句对方今天很精神
questions.textEn: Politely ask a passerby nearby for the time and praise the other person before leaving Today is very spirited

questions.text: 举杯向大家致意，然后独自痛快抿一大口！
questions.textEn: Raise a toast and take a sip alone!

questions.text: 豪气干云，直接喝掉杯里剩下的半杯酒！
questions.textEn: The arrogance was dry. Just drink the remaining half of the glass!

questions.text: 举起酒杯大喊一声“敬今晚美好的相聚！”，抿一口
questions.textEn: Raise your glass and shout, “To tonight!", take a sip

questions.text: 主动站起来，和在座的每一位玩家依次碰杯并各喝一口
questions.textEn: Take the initiative to stand up and clash with each player in turn and take a sip.

questions.text: 高举酒杯大喊：“为伟大的友谊干杯！”，畅饮一口
questions.textEn: Raise your glass and shout, “Cheers to great friendship!, take a sip

questions.text: 举高杯子原地优雅地转一圈，随后抿一口酒
questions.textEn: Raise your glass and spin gracefully, then take a sip

questions.text: 站起来举杯，向今晚所有的快乐瞬间致敬，一口干掉！
questions.textEn: Stand up and raise your glass, pay tribute to all the happy moments of tonight, and take it all in one bite!

questions.text: 手气不佳，自觉罚一口/整杯！
questions.textEn: Bad luck, consciously punish one bite/whole cup!

questions.text: 展示海量！一口气将杯中酒水一饮而尽！
questions.textEn: Show off the huge amount! Drink all the drinks in the glass in one breath!

questions.text: 霸气拿起酒瓶/饮料瓶，直接对瓶吹三大口！
questions.textEn: Hegemony picked up the bottle/drink bottle and directly blew three big mouths into the bottle!

questions.text: 化身酒神，干掉这杯并向大家展示空杯底！
questions.textEn: Embodied as Wine God, finish this cup and show everyone the empty bottom!

questions.text: 指定现场手气最差或者今天最迟到的人喝一杯
questions.textEn: Specify the person at the scene who is the least lucky or the latest to arrive today to have a drink

questions.text: 点名左边的玩家作为你的“陪酒小护卫”，陪你干一杯
questions.textEn: Toast to the player on the left as your "escort"

questions.text: 由你选出全场你觉得今晚最靓/最帅的人，请对方喝半杯
questions.textEn: You choose the person you think is the most beautiful/handsome person tonight, and invite him/her to have half a drink

questions.text: 指定现场目前手机电量最低的人，惩罚喝半杯
questions.textEn: Specify the person who currently has the lowest mobile phone power at the scene, and punish him with half a cup

questions.text: 发起“逛三园”或“成语接龙”，第一个出错的人罚酒一口
questions.textEn: Launch "Three parks" or "idiom catching the dragon", the first person to make a mistake is fined a drink

questions.text: 与左右两侧的玩家分别碰杯，顺时针轮流各喝一口
questions.textEn: Clapping the cups with the players on the left and right sides, taking turns to drink one bite each clockwise

questions.text: 全场举杯进行一次默契大碰撞，每个人抿一口
questions.textEn: A toast is raised to the whole venue for a tacit understanding collision, and everyone takes a sip

questions.text: 先干掉半杯酒，然后抽选并回答一道真心话题目
questions.textEn: First, dry half a glass of wine, then select and answer a genuine topic

questions.text: 一边喝酒，一边当场分享一件你最近发生的搞笑糗事
questions.textEn: While drinking, share a funny thing that happened to you recently on the spot

questions.text: 豪爽干杯，同时挑选现场一位玩家为你指定一项大冒险
questions.textEn: Cheers and pick a player to assign you a big adventure

questions.text: 干掉这杯，并现场对你左边的玩家说一句最走心的夸赞
questions.textEn: Kill this cup and give the most heartfelt compliment to the player on your left

questions.text: 闭上眼睛盲摸酒杯，摸到了就闭眼喝掉半杯
questions.textEn: Close your eyes and blindly touch the glass. When you touch it, close your eyes and drink half a glass.

questions.text: 用吸管优雅地喝完半杯饮料/酒
questions.textEn: Elegantly finishing half a drink/wine with a straw

questions.text: 和左边玩家玩划拳/剪刀石头布，输的人喝两口
questions.textEn: Play punching/scissors stone cloth with the player on the left, and drink two sips of the loser

questions.text: 全过程只能用非惯用手（左手/右手）端杯喝酒
questions.textEn: Drink only with non-dominant hands (left hand/right hand) throughout the process

questions.text: 反手绕过脖子（交杯酒姿势给自己）喝完这一口
questions.textEn: Backhand around the neck (hand yourself a glass of wine) Drink this mouthful

questions.text: 用手捂住眼睛，在别人的指挥下准确拿到杯子并抿一口
questions.textEn: Cover your eyes with your hand and take an accurate sip of the glass under someone else's direction

questions.text: 用极度沉痛的语气，给全场朗读你手机里最新收到的垃圾广告短信或验证码
questions.textEn: Read the latest spam SMS or verification code from your phone to the whole audience in an extremely painful tone

questions.text: 现场模仿三款经典微信表情包（如破防笑哭、狗头保命、捂脸），每个保持5秒
questions.textEn: On-site imitation of three classic WeChat emojis (such as breaking anti-laughter, keeping the dog's head alive, covering the face), each held for 5 seconds

questions.text: 假装自己是一个AI智能语音助手，用机械音回答现场玩家对你提问的3个问题
questions.textEn: Pretend to be an AI intelligent voice assistant, answering 3 questions from live players with mechanical tones

questions.text: 把自己的微信昵称临时改成“今晚的氛围担当”，直到游戏结束
questions.textEn: Temporarily change your WeChat nickname to "Tonight's atmosphere" until the end of the game

questions.text: 用浮夸的带货主播腔调（“家人们把不贵打在公屏上！”）推销你身上的某件物品30秒
questions.textEn: Use a pompous tone with the cargo anchor ("The family beat the inexpensive on the public screen!") Sell an item on you for 30 seconds

questions.text: 在场地中央展示一段无实物表演（如假装在下大雨中打伞/假装在极寒中吃热火锅）
questions.textEn: Show a no-life show in the middle of the venue (e.g., pretend to umbrella in heavy rain/pretend to eat hot pot in extreme cold)

questions.text: 用咆哮帝或琼瑶剧的夸张语气，说出：“你冷酷，你无情，你不理智！”
questions.textEn: With the exaggerated tone of Roaring Emperor or Qiong Yao Opera, say: "You are cold, you are ruthless, you are not rational!"

questions.text: 拍下一张当下自己的搞怪表情，设为自己手机锁屏壁纸直到聚会结束
questions.textEn: Take a picture of your own funny expression and set it as your mobile phone lock screen wallpaper until the end of the party

questions.text: 模仿一段经典奥斯卡获奖感言，眼含热泪地感谢在座的各位“老铁”
questions.textEn: Imitate a classic Oscar-winning speech, tearfully thanking everyone in this room "old iron"

questions.text: 展示你手机里最久远的一张未删除的照片，并讲讲当时的故事
questions.textEn: Show the oldest undeleted photo on your phone and tell the story

questions.text: 用假音唱出《卡路里》或者《燃烧我的卡路里》最灵魂的那一句
questions.textEn: Sing "Calories" or "Burn My Calories" with a fake voice

questions.text: 模仿霸道总裁吃泡面/喝白开水的无敌酷炫拽姿态
questions.textEn: Imitate the invincible cool posture of the overbearing president eating noodles/drinking boiled water

questions.text: 用美声唱法朗诵一段“清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂”
questions.textEn: Sing a beautiful voice to recite a period of "Qingming time rains, the pedestrians on the road want to break their souls"

questions.text: 做10个极其标准且带响声的拍手跳（Burpee跳或开合跳）
questions.textEn: Do 10 extremely standard loud hand claps (Burpee or open/close)

questions.text: 用超级嗲的夹子音讲一个30秒的脑筋急转弯
questions.textEn: Talk about a 30-second brainstorm with a superb clip

questions.text: 现场模仿三位在座玩家的标志性动作或口头禅
questions.textEn: Live emulation of the signature movements or mantras of the three players present

questions.text: 用慢动作（0.5倍速）展示你喝下一口饮料的全过程
questions.textEn: Use slow motion (0.5x speed) to show the whole process of taking a sip of your drink

questions.text: 在不借助手的情况下，仅凭面部肌肉将放在额头上的薯片/饼干吃到嘴里
questions.textEn: Eat chips/biscuits into your mouth on your forehead with just your facial muscles, without your hands

questions.text: 闭上眼睛，单脚站立并双手张开保持20秒不倒
questions.textEn: Close your eyes, stand on one foot and keep your hands open for 20 seconds

questions.text: 用深情的电台主播音广播：“感谢大家收听今晚的深夜心事，我是……”，并播报一段正能量语录
questions.textEn: Broadcast in your deepest radio-host voice: "Thanks for tuning in to tonight's late-night confessions, I'm..." and share an inspiring quote.

questions.text: 用大张伟式的狂热台风唱出两句流行金曲
questions.textEn: Sing two lines of a pop hit with over-the-top, high-energy showmanship.

questions.text: 现场展示你的手机屏屏幕使用时间（Screen Time），看看今天和本周哪个App用得最多
questions.textEn: Show your phone's Screen Time stats and reveal which app you use the most today and this week.

questions.text: 在社交软件上发一条“其实我是一名隐世的武林高手”状态，保持30分钟
questions.textEn: Post on social media: "Actually, I'm a reclusive martial arts master." Keep it up for 30 minutes.

questions.text: 用老牌港片配音腔说出：“阿sir，给我一个机会，我以前没得选！”
questions.textEn: Say in a classic Hong Kong movie dub voice: "Officer, give me a chance - I never had a choice!"

questions.text: 现场做一段T台模特走秀，并以极具冲击力的Pose定格结束
questions.textEn: Do a runway model walk and finish with a dramatic freeze-frame pose.

questions.text: 用充满悬疑感的纪录片旁白腔，解说现场某位正在吃东西或喝水的玩家
questions.textEn: Narrate one player who's eating or drinking right now in a suspenseful documentary voiceover style.

questions.text: 现场展示一个你隐藏的最没用但又搞笑的小特长（如动耳朵/翻眼皮/舌头舔鼻尖）
questions.textEn: Show off your most useless yet hilarious hidden talent (like wiggling your ears, flipping your eyelids, or licking your nose with your tongue).

questions.text: 把自己手机里最喜欢的一首电音/摇滚曲目放出来，并跟着打节拍疯狂摇头5秒
questions.textEn: Play your favorite EDM/rock track on your phone and headbang wildly to the beat for 5 seconds.

questions.text: 把你的手机字体大小临时调成特大号/老年代步字号，保持两轮
questions.textEn: Temporarily set your phone's font size to extra-large (grandma mode) and keep it for two rounds.

questions.text: 用充满干劲的健身教练语气大喊：“来！最后三秒！坚持住！胜利属于我们！”
questions.textEn: Shout like an energetic fitness coach: "Come on! Last three seconds! Push through! Victory is ours!"

questions.text: 做出一个超级英雄落地（Superhero Landing）的经典半跪姿势并接受大家欢呼
questions.textEn: Strike the classic Superhero Landing pose (one knee down) and soak up everyone's cheers.

questions.text: 用最正宗的译制片译制腔说：“哦我的上帝啊，瞧瞧这可爱的酒杯，我发誓要把它喝干！”
questions.textEn: Say in the most authentic dubbed-film voice: "Oh my goodness, look at this lovely glass - I swear I shall drink it dry!"

questions.text: 把纸巾垫在头上当成帽子，戴着它继续玩游戏直到下一轮结束
questions.textEn: Wear a tissue on your head as a hat and keep playing with it until the next round ends.

questions.text: 用最优雅的西餐礼仪去拿一块小零食，并用无比挑剔的美食家口吻做出点评
questions.textEn: Pick up a snack with the most elegant fine-dining etiquette and review it like a brutally picky food critic.

questions.text: 模仿一段老电视广告词（如“今年过节不收礼”），语气要充满情怀
questions.textEn: Recreate a classic TV ad jingle with heartfelt nostalgia.

questions.text: 与你右边的玩家比拼一次手力掰手腕，输的人罚饮一口
questions.textEn: Arm-wrestle the player on your right; the loser takes a sip.

questions.text: 和左边的玩家眼神死锁对视15秒，期间双方都必须保持迷之微笑
questions.textEn: Lock eyes with the player on your left for 15 seconds - both of you must keep a mysterious smile the whole time.

questions.text: 向全场指定一位玩家，真诚说出对方身上最吸引你的3个优点
questions.textEn: Point to one player and sincerely name 3 qualities about them that attract you most.

questions.text: 与左边的玩家合体做出一半爱心手势，拍照留念
questions.textEn: Complete a half-heart hand gesture with the player on your left and take a photo.

questions.text: 轻轻给右边的玩家锤背/捏肩20秒，询问对方服务满意度
questions.textEn: Gently pat the right player's back or squeeze their shoulders for 20 seconds, then ask how satisfied they are with your service.

questions.text: 握住对面玩家的手，用看手相的口吻为对方测算“今晚的财运和桃花”
questions.textEn: Hold the opposite player's hand and read their palm: predict tonight's "wealth luck and romance luck."

questions.text: 和左边玩家同步做一次“剪刀石头布”，连玩三把，输的喝一口
questions.textEn: Play Rock-Paper-Scissors with the player on your left, best of three; the loser takes a sip.

questions.text: 与右边玩家勾小指起誓：“今爱你一万年！”
questions.textEn: Pinky-swear with the player on your right: "I'll love you for ten thousand years!"

questions.text: 给左边玩家唱一段定制生日歌（不管今天是不是他生日）
questions.textEn: Sing a personalized birthday song to the player on your left (even if it's not their birthday).

questions.text: 拉着右边玩家的手，深情演唱《十年》或《朋友》的前两句
questions.textEn: Hold the right player's hand and passionately sing the first two lines of "Ten Years" or "Friends."

questions.text: 和全场每一位玩家依次进行一次充满仪式感的High Five
questions.textEn: Give a ceremonial high-five to every player in the room, one by one.

questions.text: 与左边玩家互换手机屏保为对方的自拍，直到游戏结束
questions.textEn: Swap lock screens with the player on your left - each uses the other's selfie until the game ends.

questions.text: 用深情凝视的目光看着右边玩家，直到对方忍不住笑场
questions.textEn: Gaze at the right player with deep affection until they can't hold back a laugh.

questions.text: 与左边玩家玩一次“拇指打架”游戏，三局两胜
questions.textEn: Play "thumb wrestling" with the player on your left - best of three.

questions.text: 向坐在你正对面的玩家做一个超可爱的猫咪击爪动作
questions.textEn: Do an adorable cat-paw "paw bump" toward the player sitting directly across from you.

questions.text: 给右边的玩家设计一个专属的酷炫手势（Secret Handshake）并现场表演一次
questions.textEn: Invent a custom secret handshake for the player on your right and perform it on the spot.

questions.text: 把头轻轻靠在右边玩家的背上5秒，并说“有你在真好”
questions.textEn: Lean your head gently on the right player's back for 5 seconds and say, "It's so good to have you here."

questions.text: 握住左边玩家的手腕，假装为其把脉并给出搞笑的“诊断建议”
questions.textEn: Hold the left player's wrist, pretend to take their pulse, and give a hilarious "medical diagnosis."

questions.text: 与右边玩家互夸3个回合，夸得越离谱越好
questions.textEn: Trade compliments with the right player for 3 rounds - the more outrageous, the better.

questions.text: 和对面玩家互换杯子喝一口（如不习惯可仅碰杯致意）
questions.textEn: Swap cups with the opposite player and take a sip (if you'd rather not, just clink glasses instead).

questions.text: 双手托腮，眼睛闪烁着光芒看着左边玩家15秒
questions.textEn: Rest your chin on your hands, eyes sparkling, and gaze at the left player for 15 seconds.

questions.text: 和右边玩家用脚尖轻碰一下，算作“江湖帮派暗号确认”
questions.textEn: Touch the right player's toes with yours as a "gang secret-code confirmation."

questions.text: 向左边的玩家借一件小物品（如戒指/手链），戴在自己身上直到下一轮
questions.textEn: Borrow a small item (ring/bracelet) from the left player and wear it until the next round.

questions.text: 与右边玩家面对面站立，模仿对方的动作做“镜子游戏”10秒
questions.textEn: Stand face-to-face with the right player and mirror their movements in a "mirror game" for 10 seconds.

questions.text: 给对面玩家递上一张纸巾，并附赠一个优雅的绅士/淑女弯腰礼
questions.textEn: Hand the opposite player a tissue with an elegant gentleman/lady bow.

questions.text: 和左边玩家比谁能更快眨眼10次，输的罚半杯
questions.textEn: Race the left player to blink 10 times fastest; the loser drinks half a glass.

questions.text: 牵着右边玩家的手，用极其庄严的语气说：“全宇宙最棒的队友非你莫属！”
questions.textEn: Hold the right player's hand and declare in a solemn tone: "You are without a doubt the best teammate in the entire universe!"

questions.text: 与左边玩家靠在一起，用手机拍一张“大脸搞怪特效”合影
questions.textEn: Squeeze together with the left player and take a goofy face-distortion filter selfie.

questions.text: 给右边玩家起一个今晚专属的萌萌哒绰号，并全程这么叫他/她
questions.textEn: Give the right player an adorable nickname for tonight - and use it the whole time.

questions.text: 用手轻轻抚摸一下右边玩家的头发，并夸赞一句“发质真好”
questions.textEn: Gently stroke the right player's hair and compliment them: "Such great hair."

questions.text: 和左边的玩家背靠背坐着或站着，互相用力支撑保持15秒
questions.textEn: Sit or stand back-to-back with the left player and support each other for 15 seconds.

questions.text: 闭上眼睛，由右边的玩家拿一块水果/纸巾碰你的脸，你猜碰的是哪里
questions.textEn: Close your eyes while the right player touches your face with a fruit or tissue - guess what part they touched.

questions.text: 给左边玩家做一个精致的发型造型（可以用发夹或皮筋）
questions.textEn: Give the left player a fancy hairstyle (hair clips or bands allowed).

questions.text: 与右边玩家双手紧扣，一起完成3个双人同步深蹲
questions.textEn: Interlock hands with the right player and do 3 synchronized partner squats together.

questions.text: 由左边玩家扶着你的手臂，你做一次优雅的芭蕾舞跳跃/谢幕礼
questions.textEn: Let the left player support your arm while you do an elegant ballet leap or curtain-call bow.

questions.text: 给右边的玩家喂一口现场的下酒菜或零食，并温柔地说“张嘴~”
questions.textEn: Feed the right player a bite of snack and say softly, "Open wide~"

questions.text: 与左边玩家拥抱并悬空抱起对方转一圈（若抱不动可改为背起转一圈）
questions.textEn: Hug the left player, lift them off the ground, and spin them around once (if too heavy, piggyback them instead).

questions.text: 坐在右边玩家身旁，轻轻帮对方理一理领口或袖口
questions.textEn: Sit beside the right player and gently tidy their collar or cuffs.

questions.text: 与左边玩家手牵手，像走红毯一样在场地里巡游一圈
questions.textEn: Hold hands with the left player and strut around the room like a red-carpet walk.

questions.text: 由右边玩家拿起水杯，贴心地喂你喝一口水/酒
questions.textEn: Let the right player pick up your cup and kindly feed you a sip of water/drink.

questions.text: 和左边玩家来一个极具默契的体育明星式撞胸/撞肩庆祝
questions.textEn: Do a perfectly synchronized sports-star chest/shoulder bump with the left player.

questions.text: 双手托起右边玩家的手掌，认真夸赞对方的手型30秒
questions.textEn: Hold the right player's hand in both of yours and sincerely praise their hand shape for 30 seconds.

questions.text: 让左边的玩家在你手臂上用马克笔/水笔画一个小图案（如小爱心）
questions.textEn: Let the left player draw a small doodle (like a tiny heart) on your arm with a marker.

questions.text: 与右边玩家双人合力用两根吸管将一个零食夹起来放到盘子里
questions.textEn: Team up with the right player - using two straws only - to pick up a snack and drop it onto a plate.

questions.text: 把头靠在左边玩家的大腿上（或膝盖上）保持到下局结束
questions.textEn: Rest your head on the left player's lap (or knee) until the next round ends.

questions.text: 与右边玩家配合，两人各用一只手合力为你倒一杯酒
questions.textEn: Team up with the right player - each using one hand - to pour a glass of drink for you.

questions.text: 给左边的玩家一个持续10秒的超长温暖拥抱
questions.textEn: Give the left player a long, warm 10-second hug.

questions.text: 与右边玩家并肩而坐，用手臂勾住对方的手臂（挽手姿势）保持一轮
questions.textEn: Sit side by side with the right player, arm in arm, for one full round.

questions.text: 让左边玩家帮你戴上一件饰品或贴上一张贴纸
questions.textEn: Let the left player put an accessory on you or stick a sticker on you.

questions.text: 与右边玩家双手相对，玩一次经典的“拍手躲避”小游戏
questions.textEn: Face the right player palm-to-palm and play a round of classic hand-slap dodge.

questions.text: 用脸颊轻靠在左边玩家的肩膀，表达依恋，直到下一局结束
questions.textEn: Lean your cheek on the left player's shoulder affectionately until the next round ends.

questions.text: 由右边玩家为你整理发型，保持新发型直到游戏结束
questions.textEn: Let the right player restyle your hair - keep the new look until the game ends.

questions.text: 与左边玩家手拉手，一起向全场鞠躬致意并说“谢谢大家观赏”
questions.textEn: Hold hands with the left player, bow to everyone, and say, "Thank you all for watching."

questions.text: 将右边玩家的手掌贴在你的心口，让对方感受你当下的心跳
questions.textEn: Press the right player's palm against your chest and let them feel your heartbeat.

questions.text: 靠近右边玩家的耳边，用低沉富有磁性的声音轻声说一段暧昧台词
questions.textEn: Lean close to the right player's ear and whisper a flirty line in a low, magnetic voice.

questions.text: 与左边玩家喝一次经典交杯酒
questions.textEn: Take a classic crossed-arms toast drink with the left player.

questions.text: 对右边玩家展示一段充满张力与魅力的眼杀（Eye Contact）对视10秒
questions.textEn: Give the right player an intense, magnetic eye-contact stare for 10 seconds.

questions.text: 在左边自愿玩家的手背上留下一个轻柔的吻
questions.textEn: Plant a gentle kiss on the back of the left (willing) player's hand.

questions.text: 与右边玩家十指紧扣，轻轻扶住对方的后颈对视15秒
questions.textEn: Interlace fingers with the right player, gently hold the back of their neck, and lock eyes for 15 seconds.

questions.text: 轻轻凑到左边玩家的锁骨附近或耳际，轻吹一口气
questions.textEn: Lean close to the left player's collarbone or ear and blow a soft breath.

questions.text: 与右边玩家贴面合影一张，要求气场拉满、极其有情侣氛围感
questions.textEn: Take a cheek-to-cheek photo with the right player - maximum couple vibes required.

questions.text: 从背后轻轻环抱住左边自愿玩家，维持动作10秒
questions.textEn: Gently wrap your arms around the left (willing) player from behind and hold for 10 seconds.

questions.text: 用极具撩人张力的眼神，看着右边自愿玩家并咬一下下唇
questions.textEn: Look at the right (willing) player with a sultry, charged gaze and bite your lower lip.

questions.text: 与右边自愿玩家分享同一根薯条/饼干棒，吃到距离不足3厘米
questions.textEn: Share a single fry/cookie stick with the right (willing) player until your mouths are less than 3 cm apart.

questions.text: 在左边玩家的额头或脸颊上亲吻一下
questions.textEn: Kiss the left player on the forehead or cheek.

questions.text: 让右边玩家坐在你的大腿上，两人共同喝完半杯酒
questions.textEn: Have the right player sit on your lap while you two finish half a glass together.

questions.text: 在左边玩家耳边用极低的声音说出对方今晚最让你心动的部位
questions.textEn: Whisper in the left player's ear - at the lowest volume - which part of them captivated you most tonight.

questions.text: 与右边玩家近距离壁咚（或椅咚）5秒，眼神不能回避
questions.textEn: Do a close-up wall-slam (or chair-slam) on the right player for 5 seconds - no averting your eyes.

questions.text: 用最温柔的手势，为左边玩家擦拭唇角或面颊
questions.textEn: With the gentlest touch, wipe the left player's lip corner or cheek.

questions.text: 与右边自愿玩家互换一件贴身饰品（如外套/手链/戒指）并戴上
questions.textEn: Swap a personal item (jacket/bracelet/ring) with the right (willing) player and wear theirs.

questions.text: 把头深深埋在左边自愿玩家的颈窝处，保持5秒
questions.textEn: Burrow your head into the left (willing) player's neck hollow and hold for 5 seconds.

questions.text: 用深情无比的眼神盯着右边自愿玩家，并慢慢拉近距离直到呼吸可闻
questions.textEn: Stare at the right (willing) player with deep affection and slowly close the distance until you can feel each other's breath.

questions.text: 在左边自愿玩家的掌心亲一口，并用手把对方的手掌合上
questions.textEn: Kiss the left (willing) player's palm, then gently fold their hand closed.

questions.text: 与右边自愿玩家搂腰对视，假装跳一段慢板探戈/华尔兹10秒
questions.textEn: Hold the right (willing) player's waist, gaze at each other, and fake a slow tango/waltz for 10 seconds.

questions.text: 靠近左边自愿玩家，用气音附耳说出一个关于你的隐藏秘密
questions.textEn: Lean close to the left (willing) player and whisper a hidden secret about yourself into their ear.

questions.text: 走向附近一位路人或隔壁桌，礼貌且自信地询问：“请问我今天的穿搭打几分？”
questions.textEn: Approach a nearby stranger or the next table and ask politely with confidence: "Rate my outfit today, out of ten?"

questions.text: 走向隔壁桌，极其有礼貌地向对方借一根薯条或一块冰块
questions.textEn: Walk to the next table and very politely ask to borrow one french fry or an ice cube.

questions.text: 走向服务员或店员，真诚微笑地对对方说一句：“你今晚忙碌的样子真的非常帅气/漂亮！”
questions.textEn: Walk up to a server or staff member and say with a genuine smile: "You look really handsome/gorgeous when you're busy tonight!"

questions.text: 走向隔壁桌，向其中一位客人询问：“请问你觉得今晚这里的哪款饮料最好喝？”
questions.textEn: Approach the next table and ask one of the guests: "Which drink here do you think tastes best tonight?"

questions.text: 向路过的陌生人隔空大方比心，并抛出一个飞吻😘
questions.textEn: Blow a big heart sign and a flying kiss to a passing stranger.

questions.text: 走到附近陌生人面前，一本正经地问：“请问今晚银河系的月亮是在哪个方向升起来的？”
questions.textEn: Walk up to a nearby stranger and ask with a totally straight face: "Excuse me, which direction does the galaxy's moon rise from tonight?"

questions.text: 礼貌邀请隔壁桌的客人与全场玩家共同举杯大喊一声“干杯！”
questions.textEn: Politely invite the next table to join everyone in raising glasses and shouting "Cheers!"

questions.text: 走向一位路人，礼貌地向对方请教一个生活小妙招或推荐一首歌曲
questions.textEn: Approach a passerby and politely ask for a life hack tip or a song recommendation.

questions.text: 走过去对隔壁桌的朋友说：“祝你们今天好运爆发，今晚吃得开心！”
questions.textEn: Go over to the next table and say: "Wishing you a burst of good luck today - enjoy your meal tonight!"

questions.text: 向店员或服务员要一杯温水，并微笑着奉上一句“辛苦啦”
questions.textEn: Ask a staff member for a glass of warm water and offer a smile with a sincere "Thanks for your hard work."

questions.text: 找一位陌生人询问时间，并夸奖对方戴的手表/服饰好看
questions.textEn: Ask a stranger for the time, then compliment their watch or outfit.

questions.text: 隔着一两桌的距离，向另一桌的朋友大方挥手致意并露出灿烂笑容
questions.textEn: From one or two tables away, wave generously at another table with a bright smile.

questions.text: 走到酒吧/餐厅前台，向调酒师或工作人员送上一句真诚的节日/夜间祝福
questions.textEn: Go to the bar/restaurant counter and offer the bartender or staff a sincere holiday/evening blessing.

questions.text: 找一位路人，礼貌地向对方推荐现场你觉得最好吃的一道菜/饮料
questions.textEn: Find a passerby and politely recommend your favorite dish or drink here.

questions.text: 向路过的陌生人击掌（High Five），如果对方回应则全场欢呼
questions.textEn: High-five a passing stranger - if they respond, everyone cheers.

questions.text: 走过去对隔壁桌一位朋友说：“你长得非常像我一位很优秀的旧友！”
questions.textEn: Walk over to someone at the next table and say: "You look a lot like an amazing old friend of mine!"

questions.text: 走向一位陌生人，真诚询问：“今晚你快乐吗？祝你有个美好的夜晚！”
questions.textEn: Approach a stranger and ask sincerely: "Are you happy tonight? Wishing you a wonderful evening!"

questions.text: 请隔壁桌的朋友帮你随机报一个数字（1-100），报多少，你就需要拥抱多少人（人可重复利用）
questions.textEn: Ask someone at the next table for a random number (1-100) - you must hug that many people (repeats allowed).

questions.text: 走向一位路人，做出一副星探的姿态说：“打扰一下，你身上有一种特别的主角光环！”
questions.textEn: Approach a passerby like a talent scout and say: "Excuse me, you have a special protagonist aura about you!"

questions.text: 礼貌向路人问厕所怎么走，并在离开时行一个优雅的绅士/淑女礼
questions.textEn: Politely ask a passerby for directions to the restroom, then bow gracefully like a gentleman/lady as you leave.
